title: Permute Matrix
text: Reorder matrix rows or columns, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Invalid permutation index} sets Response to an invalid; {Permute}, {Index mode} and {Error when length of P is not equal to Permute dimension size} sets the error message for P length. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Invalid permutation index
params.values: Response to an invalid index value Clip index (default) | Clip and warn | Generate error

params.name: Error when length of P is not equal to Permute dimension size
params.values: Error message for P length off (default) | on
